slides.title: Avocado Glow Cream 15 g
slides.text: Our simplest cream: avocado + aloe vera

slides.title: Soft, light, gentle
slides.text: Whipped texture that spreads easily. No kojic acid, no niacinamide.

slides.title: How to use
steps: Wash your face and pat dry
Dot on forehead, cheeks, nose, chin
slides.text: Patch test behind the ear first

slides.title: By skin type
steps: Dry or normal: morning and night
Oily: a very thin layer or night only
slides.text: One 15 g jar lasts about 3–4 weeks
